verdict.rationale: Superpowers is a library of workflow skills (brainstorming, planning, TDD, subagent review) that runs inside third-party coding-agent harnesses. It has no user data store or analytics surface of its own, so 'AI-generated insights from my data inside the product' does not fit this kind of product. Its brainstorming and review guidance about code tasks is a coding-workflow capability, not data insights, and none of the evidence shows a data-insights feature that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
